answer: Re-attestations are stored in voyage and vertex lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the echo graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 859 impostors cost 1799 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
